maya (Product): MarinerHealth asked for a private pilot: per-tenant cache, customer keys (BYOK), and a 120ms P95 target for gen. They want a pilot asap — can we scope a safe MVP?

raj (Eng-Runtime): Short: doable if we accept tradeoffs. BYOK avoids HSM latency but we need envelope flow and more mem for per-tenant KV. To hit 120ms we should pin to 7B quant variant and aggressive prewarm.

emma (Infra): Reserved GPUs + prewarm required. Normal lead = 10bd, can compress to 4-6bd with prioritized tickets. Also need firewall rules to reach customer KMS.

sofia (Security): Full HSM + attestation adds ~3w. We can run BYOK under a temporary exception with strict audit logs and rotation policy. I can draft the exception template in 48h.

ben (Eng-SRE): Observability: per-tenant latency dashboards, token cost, and alert at 150ms. Recommend canary limit to MarinerHealth traffic and an automated fallback to hosted model on breaches. Ill prepare runbook.

maya (Product): Two choices: Fast pilot = BYOK + per-tenant cache -> ETA ~7-10bd. Secure = HSM path -> ETA ~3-4w. Proposal: Fast pilot to validate; owners: raj runtime, emma infra, sofia sec, ben SRE. Ack + ETAs?

raj (Eng-Runtime): Ack. 72h for runtime flag + fallback + basic load test.

emma (Infra): Ack. 5bd to provision reserved pool; 3bd if exec escalates.

sofia (Security): Ack. Exception draft 48h, legal review next.

ben (Eng-SRE): Ack. Canary runbook + dashboards by EOW; will include rollback steps.

ops-bot: Created ticket MARINER-PRIVATE-PILOT: https://tickets/MARINER-PRIVATE-PILOT — update timelines in ticket.

maya (Product): I'll confirm scope with MarinerHealth: "BYOK + per-tenant cache + 120ms P95 target; traffic scoped to pilot." Weekly check-ins until pilot complete. Reopen if blockers.
